Meta.title: Noiz Systems — We build the apps that move African commerce
Meta.description: Noiz Systems designs, ships and operates its own products — BDMarket for African groceries, and the logistics platform that delivers them.
Meta.ogDescription: Product company building commerce and logistics software for the African diaspora. Paris & beyond.

Hero.kicker: Product company · Paris & the African diaspora
Hero.title: We build the apps that <accent>move</accent> African commerce.
Hero.body: Noiz Systems designs, ships and operates its own products — BDMarket for African groceries, and the logistics platform that delivers them. Two brothers, one vision, engineered software.
Hero.mediaLabel: hero photo — market / delivery in motion

Products.title: Our products
Products.lede: Owned end to end — from the storefront a customer taps to the route a driver runs.

bdmarket.name: BDMarket
bdmarket.title: African groceries, delivered
bdmarket.body: A mobile marketplace for African foods and household goods: curated vendors, familiar products, prices that make sense, delivery scheduled around the neighbourhood.

bullets.diaspora: Diaspora ordering for family back home

logistics.name: Noiz Logistics
logistics.title: The delivery layer underneath
logistics.body: Dispatch, routing, proof of delivery and fleet visibility — the same system that runs BDMarket orders, opened up to merchants and carriers who need it.

Capabilities.title: What we do
Capabilities.lede: The same team that operates our products builds for selected partners.

mobile.title: Mobile products
mobile.body: Consumer apps built for low bandwidth, mobile money and mid-range Android — the conditions our markets actually run on.

logistics.title: Logistics systems
logistics.body: Dispatch, tracking and last-mile operations, including the field workflows that keep drivers moving without a stable signal.

platform.title: Platform engineering
platform.body: APIs, payments integration and the operational tooling a product needs on day two — not just the launch screen.

groundTruth.title: Ground truth
groundTruth.body: We spend time in the market — vendors, drivers, customers — before a screen is drawn.

blueprint.title: Blueprint
blueprint.body: Flows, data model and the operational reality mapped in one document before build.

ship.title: Ship in weeks
ship.body: A working release every two weeks, in real hands, with the metrics that matter instrumented.

operate.title: Operate
operate.body: We run what we build: support, on-call, and iteration against live operations.

Markets.title: Markets we serve
Markets.body: One city at a time, done properly. BDMarket is live in Paris and Île-de-France, serving the African diaspora with the vendors and products they already shop for.
Markets.note: Next markets are under review — confirm before publishing.

scheduledDelivery.title: BDMarket adds scheduled neighbourhood delivery
scheduledDelivery.body: Orders now group by street and time slot, cutting the cost per drop.

offlineTracking.title: Offline-first tracking in the driver app
offlineTracking.body: Deliveries record and sync later — no dead zones in the proof-of-delivery chain.

origins.title: Two brothers, one vision: how Noiz started
origins.body: From a family grocery run to a marketplace and the fleet behind it.

clientWork.question: Do you build apps for other companies?
clientWork.answer: Yes — selectively, and mostly in commerce and logistics where our own products give us an unfair advantage. Book a call and we will tell you honestly whether we are the right team.

standaloneLogistics.question: Can merchants use the logistics platform on its own?
standaloneLogistics.answer: Yes. Dispatch, driver app and proof of delivery work independently of BDMarket, with an API for handing orders over from your own storefront.

payments.question: How do you handle payments?
payments.answer: Mobile money first, cards and cash on delivery where the market expects them. Payment methods are configured per market, not hard-coded.

raising.question: Are you raising?
raising.answer: We talk to investors who know African commerce. Use the form and mark your role as investor — we will send the current deck.

Contact.title: Book a <accent>call</accent>
Contact.body: Tell us what you are moving and who you are moving it for. One of the founders replies — usually within a working day.
